# iAM Capital

> iAM Capital Group Ltd is a European private equity investment group, founded in 1997 and based in London, that deploys capital into alternative investment strategies with a focus on real estate and hospitality-led investment in Southern Europe. Its fully owned subsidiary, iAM Invest Ltd, is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority.

## Pages

- [Home](https://iamcapital.com/)
- [About](https://iamcapital.com/about/): who we are, regulatory framework, active and exited funds, history since 1997
- [Investments](https://iamcapital.com/investments/): every property, active and sold, on a map and as cards, with links to each property's page
- [Team](https://iamcapital.com/team/): Board of Directors, investments and fundraising, operations
- [Responsibility](https://iamcapital.com/responsibility/): ESG principles and legal disclosures (governance, modern slavery, MIFIDPRU disclosure, ESG risk, disclaimer, regulatory, fraud awareness, privacy)
- [Investor Relations](https://iamcapital.com/investor-relations/): shareholder notices and annual reports
- [News](https://iamcapital.com/latest-news/): press releases, coverage and events
- [Contact](https://iamcapital.com/contact/)
